notice: Two short live-web tasks that exercise the whole runner: leader, browser, transcript, screenshots, judge. Facts verified 2026-09-23.

tasks.title: Read a page's heading and link
tasks.summary: Open example.com and report its main heading and where its only link goes.
tasks.task: Open https://example.com in the browser. Tell me the page's main heading and the full address its only link points to.
tasks.rubric:
# Rubric: smoke-001

## How to judge (applies to every item)
Judge from the trajectory, the final result, and the screenshots. Credit a value only if the trajectory shows it on the page.

## Source facts (verified live 2026-09-23)
- The main heading is "Example Domain".
- The only link points to https://iana.org/domains/example.

## Items
A1_heading — The final result gives the heading "Example Domain".
A2_link — The final result gives the link address https://iana.org/domains/example (http/https or a trailing slash may differ).
A3_grounded — The trajectory shows the agent loading example.com in the browser, not recalling the page.

tasks.title: Search Wikipedia and read one fact
tasks.summary: Use Wikipedia's search box to find Kurt Gödel's article and report his date of birth.
tasks.task: Go to https://en.wikipedia.org, use the site's search box to find the article about Kurt Gödel, open it, and tell me his date of birth as the article states it.
tasks.rubric:
# Rubric: smoke-002

## How to judge (applies to every item)
Judge from the trajectory, the final result, and the screenshots. Credit a value only if the trajectory shows it on the page.

## Source facts (verified live 2026-09-23)
- The article is https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Kurt_G%C3%B6del.
- Its infobox gives his birth date as 28 April 1906 (April 28, 1906).

## Rulings
- Navigating straight to the article URL without the search box violates A1 but not A2 or A3.

## Items
A1_search_used — The trajectory shows a query typed into Wikipedia's search box and the article reached from it.
A2_article_opened — The trajectory shows the Kurt Gödel article open.
A3_birth_date — The final result gives 28 April 1906 in any date format.
